about.title: About Sahaf
about.lead: Sahaf is an imaginary online bookshop that sells classics in its own cover series. As a portfolio project it shows the full flow of a real e-commerce site: catalogue, cart, payment, order tracking and an admin panel.
about.demoText: Create an account, confirm your e-mail and add books to your cart. Payments run in Stripe test mode; no money leaves your card.
about.demoExpiry: Use any future date as the expiry date and any three digits as the CVC.
about.demoSleep: The site runs on a free server; if nobody has used it for a while, the first page can take about half a minute to load.
about.seriesText: Every work in the catalogue is a public-domain classic. The covers are drawn automatically from the book details, so each book has its own colours and pattern.
about.techText: ASP.NET Core MVC, Entity Framework Core, PostgreSQL, ASP.NET Core Identity, Stripe Checkout and Resend. The source code is open on GitHub.
about.privacyText: Only what an account and an order need (name, e-mail, delivery address) is stored. Card details never reach this site; Stripe handles them directly. You can delete your account from the profile page.
